name: audioextender
description: A local macOS command-line tool that analyzes an existing track, selects strong beat-aligned phrases near the beginning and end, and exports a stereo WAV with a DJ-friendly intro and outro. The full original track remains present between the added sections.

scripts.check:syntax: node --check web/app.js && node --check web/api-client.js && node --check web/background-task-controller.js && node --check web/frontend-services.js && node --check web/import-issues.js && node --check web/import-workspace.js && node --check web/local-audio-import.js && node --check web/playlist-import.js && node --check web/processing-workspace.js && node --check web/request-state-controller.js && node --check web/shared-components.js && node --check web/playback.js && node --check web/music-files.js && node --check web/dj-library.js && node --check web/set-builder.js && node --check web/set-builder-api.js && node --check web/set-builder-classic-planner.js && node --check web/set-builder-commands.js && node --check web/set-builder-state.js && node --check web/set-builder-view-model.js && node --check web/set-planning-client.js && node --check web/settings.js && node --check web/reporting.js && node --check web/import-queue.js
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage:js && npm run coverage:python
scripts.coverage:python: .venv/bin/python -m coverage erase && .venv/bin/python -m coverage run -m unittest discover -s tests && .venv/bin/python -m coverage report -m && .venv/bin/python -m coverage json && .venv/bin/python -m coverage lcov -o coverage/lcov-python.info
